notes: REDHAT-FIX-H2: every literal_cmd uses the real bun dispatcher (not PATH holo stubs).
Step 6 must observe a named restore-path failure — never sole-green on 'unknown flag: --pitr'.
Executable oracle suite: PLATFORM_IT=1 pnpm vitest run services/platform/tests/integration/sprint28-human-gate-oracles.test.ts

steps.text: Run holo restore --pitr <timestamp> against a scratch DB — restores to the named point exactly (or fail-closed outside WAL with named error).
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step1-scratch; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts restore --pitr "${PITR_TIMESTAMP:-2099-01-01T00:00:00Z}" --scratch .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step1-scratch --target-action promote 2>&1 | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step1-restore.txt; ! grep -q 'unknown flag: --pitr' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step1-restore.txt

assertion.notes: Valid in-window PITR → exit 0 + SELECT 1. Outside-window / empty → non-zero named restore error. Never unknown flag: --pitr.

steps.text: Provision / prove a fresh restore target with zero mini access (multi-axis isolation PASS).
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; MINI_HOST="${MINI_HOST:-203.0.113.1}" MINI_IPV4="${MINI_IPV4:-203.0.113.1}" MINI_IPV6="${MINI_IPV6:-2001:db8::1}" MINI_TAILNET_IP="${MINI_TAILNET_IP:-203.0.113.2}" MINI_LAN_IP="${MINI_LAN_IP:-203.0.113.3}" MINI_DNS_ALIASES="${MINI_DNS_ALIASES:-mini.invalid}" MINI_SOCKET_DEFAULTS="${MINI_SOCKET_DEFAULTS:-0}" MINI_UNIX_SOCKETS="${MINI_UNIX_SOCKETS:-/tmp/.s.PGSQL.5432-gate-absent}" TARGET_ATTESTED_IDENTITY="${TARGET_ATTESTED_IDENTITY:-target-vm-uuid-gate}" MINI_ATTESTED_IDENTITY="${MINI_ATTESTED_IDENTITY:-mini-hw-uuid-gate}" REQUIRE_ATTESTED_IDENTITY=1 R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID="${R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-ro-test}" R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="${R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-ro-test}" R2_CREDENTIAL_KIND=object-read-only R2_CREDENTIAL_POLICY='{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::holocron-backup"]},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::holocron-backup/*"]}]}' NC_TIMEOUT_SEC=1 bash scripts/prove-isolation.sh 2>&1 | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step2-isolation.txt; grep -qE 'RESULT:[[:space:]]+PASS' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step2-isolation.txt

steps.text: Compare row counts pre/post-restore — exact match against the pre-failure snapshot (parity-report row_counts).
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step3-scratch .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step3-blob; bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts restore:fire-drill --target-timestamp "${PITR_TIMESTAMP:?set PITR_TIMESTAMP to an in-window ISO}" --scratch .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step3-scratch --blob-dir .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step3-blob --report .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/parity-report.json 2>&1 | tee .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step3-fire-drill.txt; test -f .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/parity-report.json; jq -e '.POSTGRES_PARITY_PASS == true and (.row_counts | type == "object")' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/parity-report.json

steps.text: Compare the evidence-ledger chain pre/post-restore — as-of chain SHA-256 matches baseline.
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; test -f .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/parity-report.json; jq -e '.LEDGER_CHECKSUM_MATCH == true and ((.ledger_sha256 // .ledgerDigest // .LEDGER_SHA256 // "") | tostring | test("^[a-f0-9]{64}$"; "i"))' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/parity-report.json

steps.text: Restore blob storage on the fresh target — every object SHA-256 matches (BLOB_PARITY_PASS + matched_objects >= 1).
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; test -f .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/parity-report.json; jq -e '.BLOB_PARITY_PASS == true and (.matched_objects // .blob_matched_objects // 0) >= 1' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/parity-report.json

steps.text: Point restore at an empty/corrupted backup chain — restore fails closed with a named chain error; never fake success; never sole-green on unknown flag: --pitr.
steps.literal_cmd: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step6-scratch; EMPTY_PREFIX="pgbackrest-s28-gate-empty/${GATE_RUN_ID:-manual}"; set +e; R2_PGBACKREST_PREFIX="$EMPTY_PREFIX" bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts restore --pitr 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z --scratch .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step6-scratch --target-action promote > .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step6-restore.txt 2>&1; RC=$?; set -e; cat .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step6-restore.txt; test "$RC" -ne 0; ! grep -q 'unknown flag: --pitr' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step6-restore.txt; grep -qiE 'no base backup available|backup chain missing|manifest checksum mismatch|WAL segment corrupted|backup chain integrity|outside available WAL|backup config missing secrets' .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step6-restore.txt; test "$(find .tmp/REDHAT-FIX-H2/step6-scratch -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 0

assertion.notes: Outer script exits 0 only when restore domain fail-closed is proven. must_not_observe unknown-flag-only.
require_all_regex: no base backup available|backup chain missing|manifest checksum|WAL segment corrupted|outside available WAL|backup config missing secrets
